name: Facial Hair
overview: Scripture addresses facial hair with specific instructions and symbolic significance, emphasizing respect for God's design and covenant people. Leviticus commands not to mar or shave the corners of the beard, highlighting a distinction in appearance for God's people. Expressions of grief or astonishment, as seen in Ezra, include plucking hair from the head and beard, while prophetic passages in Isaiah depict the cutting or consuming of beards as a sign of judgment and desolation. The imagery in Psalms associates the beard with blessing and anointing, underscoring its sacred symbolism.
